purpose: Chicago food and bar taste file for McClelland family agents. Prefer this over Google Maps Recents (Recents is search history, not visits).
notes: Google Timeline GPS is block-level. Adjacent storefronts get mixed up; trust named corrections over pin labels.
Recs should be clickable Google Maps links that open the business listing with walking directions from current location (place name, not a raw address).
Michelin mention is a plus, not a filter. Dives count if food or vibe is really good. High Google ratings are a quality signal.

taste.vibe: neighborhood gastropub and real pubs, not generic sports bars, except Third Rail before United Center

regulars.name: Printers Row Wine Shop
regulars.why: South Loop happy-hour regular. Do not confuse with Vitalogy next door at 723.

regulars.name: Third Rail Tavern
regulars.why: Always go here before United Center. Do not confuse with Ryota at 1131.

regulars.name: Buttercup
regulars.why: South Loop cafe by day, bar at night. Neighborhood visits.

loved.name: Chief O'Neill's Pub
loved.why: Aug 30 2026 after Waveland Bowl. Both loved it: baked onion soup, Guinness cheddar soup, pot roast, chicken pot pie, Guinness, authentic Irish band.

loved.name: Armitage Alehouse
loved.why: Named like: pike fish and chips, British/Indian pub fare. Rare as a Timeline visit.

loved.name: Longman & Eagle
loved.why: Named like; reserved Jan 31 2026. Did not show as a Timeline pin.

loved.name: Pleasant House Pub
loved.why: Named like: Royal pies; fish and chips on Fridays. Pilsen.

not_these_pins: Ryota (1131 W Madison) — next door to Third Rail, GPS mixup
Vitalogy (723 S Dearborn) — next door to Printers Row Wine Shop, GPS mixup
